name: Furbaide Ferbend

attributes.attribute: used a sling to kill Medb

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Furbaide Ferbend is an Irish hero. He is one of the Ulster warriors. He killed the great queen of Connacht, Medb, who was his aunt. He hit her with a thrown sling stone. The hero's mother was Clothra, a sister of Medb. Medb had ended the mother. The queen died at the same place on the Shannon River where she had done wrong. The mother's death was answered there.

okr.objective: Furbaide Ferbend avenges his mother by killing the queen.
key_results: He killed the queen with a flung stone.
The gem was paid back at one place.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
